format: Neo Revelation (N3, 2001): cards not already in the pool. Unlimited only. Shining Magikarp 66 is Celebrations' Classic Collection card (CEL CC10).

attacks.name: Attract Current
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, you may search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Lightning Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Gigavolt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If tails, this attack does 40 damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Softboiled
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand, you may flip a coin. If heads, remove 8 damage counters from this Pokémon. If tails, remove 4 damage counters from this Pokémon. Either way, if this Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Time Travel
abilities.text: If an opponent's attack would Knock Out this Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, it isn't Knocked Out and you shuffle it and all cards attached to it into your deck. This power doesn't work if this Pokémon was already Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed before that attack (your ruling).

attacks.name: Psychic Damage
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, put 1 damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Triggered Poison
attacks.text: If your opponent attaches an Energy card to the Defending Pokémon during their next turn, that Pokémon becomes Poisoned.

attacks.name: Cross Attack
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads. If you get 2 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Present
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If exactly 1 is heads, this attack does 40 damage. If exactly 2 are heads, remove 3 damage counters from the Defending Pokémon. If the Defending Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them. If all 3 are heads, this attack does 60 damage. If all 3 are tails, remove all damage counters from the Defending Pokémon.

abilities.name: Howl
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand, you may discard the top 5 cards of your deck (all of them if you have fewer). If any of those are Fire Energy cards, attach them to any of your Fire Pokémon of your choice. Using this power ends your turn.

attacks.name: Searing Flames
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy cards attached to this Pokémon or this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Stoke
attacks.text: You may search your deck for a Fire Energy card and attach it to this Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Sacred Fire
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

attacks.name: Dive Bomb
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Dark Flame
attacks.text: Discard 1 Fire Energy card attached to this Pokémon or this attack does nothing. If there are any Darkness Energy cards in your discard pile (basic or Special: your ruling), attach 1 of them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Black Fang
attacks.text: Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Darkness Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Evolutionary Spore
attacks.text: Choose any number of your Hoppip and Skiploom. Then, for each Pokémon you chose, you may search your deck for a card that evolves from that Pokémon and attach it to that Pokémon (this counts as evolving it). Shuffle your deck afterward.

abilities.name: Electromagnetic Power
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may take 1 Energy card attached to 1 of your Magnemite, Magneton or Dark Magneton and attach it to a different 1 of them. Not while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Plasma
attacks.text: If there are any Lightning Energy cards in your discard pile, attach 1 of them to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Night Eyes
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Perish Song
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep and was attacked with Night Eyes during your last turn, it is Knocked Out.

abilities.name: Energy Converter
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose 1 basic Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon and choose an Energy type. Treat that Energy card as that type until the end of your turn. Not while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed; if it becomes Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed, the Energy card goes back to its original type.

attacks.name: Delta Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose whether the Defending Pokémon becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

abilities.name: Lightning Burst
abilities.text: Whenever you attach a Lightning Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon, if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, they choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. It stops working while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Lightning Tackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this Pokémon does 20 damage to itself.

abilities.name: Crystal Body
abilities.text: Prevent all effects of your opponent's attacks, other than damage, done to this Pokémon. It stops working while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Aurora Wave
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If only 1 is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

abilities.name: Prehistoric Memory
abilities.text: Whenever an Evolved Pokémon attacks (your opponent's too), it can use any attack from its Basic Pokémon card or any Evolution card attached to it. It still has to pay for that attack's Energy cost. It stops working while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fly
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon. If tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

attacks.name: Psychic Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads. Remove a number of damage counters from this Pokémon equal to the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). If this Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

abilities.name: Legendary Body
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, it and the Energy cards attached to it aren't affected by effects from Trainer cards other than Stadium cards (yours too: your ruling). As long as this power is active, discard any Trainer cards attached to this Pokémon. (It works even if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.)

attacks.name: Mega Flame
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each tails, discard 1 Fire Energy card from this Pokémon, if it has any.

attacks.name: Rainbow Burn
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each type of basic Energy card attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Genetic Memory
attacks.text: Use any attack from this Pokémon's Basic Pokémon card or Evolution card (it doesn't have to pay for that attack's Energy cost).

attacks.name: Twister
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon, if any, and discard it. If both are tails, this attack does nothing (not even damage).

attacks.name: Aerowing
attacks.text: You may flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 80 damage. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Thundershock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Lightning Strike
attacks.text: You may discard all Lightning Energy cards attached to this Pokémon. If you do, this attack does 80 damage.

abilities.name: Legendary Body
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, it and the Energy cards attached to it aren't affected by effects from Trainer cards other than Stadium cards (yours too: your ruling). As long as this power is active, discard any Trainer cards attached to this Pokémon. (It works even if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.)

attacks.name: Lightning Spark
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of them and this attack does 20 damage to it. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Fury Attack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Agility
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Swipe
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard all Trainer cards attached to your opponent's Pokémon.

attacks.name: Quick Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Core Stream
attacks.text: Choose an Energy type other than Colorless. This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon with any Energy cards of that type attached to it. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

abilities.name: Mimic
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, it copies all of the Defending Pokémon's attacks, including their costs. Not while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Slam
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

abilities.name: Legendary Body
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, it and the Energy cards attached to it aren't affected by effects from Trainer cards other than Stadium cards (yours too: your ruling). As long as this power is active, discard any Trainer cards attached to this Pokémon. (It works even if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.)

attacks.name: Crystal Wave
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, this attack does 30 damage and, if your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, they choose 1 of them and switch it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Tail Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Screech
attacks.text: Until the end of your next turn, if an attack damages the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), that attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Poison Bite
attacks.text: If this attack damages the Defending Pokémon, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned and you remove a number of damage counters from this Pokémon equal to half that damage (rounded up to the nearest 10).

attacks.name: Earthquake
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your own Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Rock Tumble
attacks.text: Don't apply Resistance.

attacks.name: Freezing Kiss Goodnight
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Strange Dance
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.

abilities.name: Submerge
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may change this Pokémon's type to Water until the end of your turn. Not while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed. If this Pokémon becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed after you have used this power, its type changes back to Lightning.

attacks.name: Blinding Light
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

abilities.name: Magma Pool
abilities.text: If this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and moves to the Bench, remove 1 Fire Energy card attached to it, if any, and attach it to the new Active Pokémon. (You can't choose an Energy card that you used to pay the Retreat Cost.)

attacks.name: Lava Flow
attacks.text: You may discard any number of Fire Energy cards attached to this Pokémon when you use this attack. If you do, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage for each Fire Energy card you discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Constrict
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Octazooka
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, whenever the Defending Pokémon attacks, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing. (Benching or evolving that Pokémon ends this effect.)

abilities.name: Allergic Pollen
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is in play, cards in any player's discard pile aren't affected by attacks or Pokémon Powers (not Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies or Abilities: your ruling). It stops working while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Sleep Pinchers
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Nap
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from this Pokémon. If it has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: High-Speed Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 30 damage to itself. This Pokémon can't use this attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Rising Lunge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Horn Swipe
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 40 more damage. If 1 or both of them are tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Terrorize
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is a Basic Pokémon, choose 1 of its attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Overhead Toss
attacks.text: If you have any Benched Pokémon, flip a coin. If tails, this attack does 10 damage to 1 of them. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.name: Unown [B]
cards.text: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names (your ruling: with this card in your deck, all of them count together toward 4, whatever their letter).

abilities.name: [Bear]
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your other Pokémon with Unown in its name to this Pokémon. Not if this Pokémon has 10 HP left. (It can be used even if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.)

cards.name: Unown [Y]
cards.text: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names (your ruling: with this card in your deck, all of them count together toward 4, whatever their letter).

abilities.name: [Yield]
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Psychic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon with Unown in its name. Shuffle your deck afterward. (It can be used even if this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.)

attacks.name: Grab
attacks.text: Choose a Trainer card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Your opponent shuffles that card into their deck.

attacks.name: Positive Ion
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage. If tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Negative Ion
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon attacks this Pokémon during your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon is reduced by 10 (before applying Weakness and Resistance). (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Leek Jab
attacks.text: This attack can't be used during your next turn. (Benching this Pokémon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Fin Smack
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon card named Murkrow and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward. (You can't use this attack if your Bench is full.)

attacks.name: Flock Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin for each Murkrow on your Bench. This attack does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each heads.

attacks.name: Sleep Spore
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Whirlpool
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, choose 1 of them and discard it.

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Needle Storm
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads you get.

attacks.name: Sharpshooting
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance.

abilities.name: Hard Shell
abilities.text: Whenever an attack (including your own) does 40 or less damage to this Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), reduce that damage to 10. (Any other effects of attacks still happen.) It stops working while this Pokémon is Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Toxic Saliva
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. It now takes 20 Poison damage instead of 10 after each player's turn (even if it was already Poisoned).

attacks.name: Mysterious Powder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Magma Ring
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.name: Smoochum
cards.text: Baby Rule: if this Baby Pokémon is your Active Pokémon and your opponent announces an attack, they flip a coin before doing anything else. On tails, their turn ends. It can evolve into Jynx (any card named Jynx).

attacks.name: Psykiss
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose a Special Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. Your opponent shuffles that card into their deck.

attacks.name: Raging Headbutt
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage plus 10 damage times the number of damage counters on this Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 10 damage.

attacks.name: Bubblebeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.name: Unown [K]
cards.text: You may have up to 4 Basic Pokémon cards in your deck with Unown in their names (your ruling: with this card in your deck, all of them count together toward 4, whatever their letter).

abilities.name: [Keep]
abilities.text: Your opponent's attacks, Pokémon Powers and Trainer cards can't discard Energy cards from your Pokémon with Unown in their names. (Any other effects still happen.) (Not affected by this Pokémon being Asleep, Confused or Paralyzed: it has no such clause, your ruling.)

attacks.name: Poison Spray
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.name: Balloon Berry
cards.text: When the Pokémon this card is attached to retreats, discard this card instead of discarding Energy cards (your ruling: even with a Retreat Cost of 0).

cards.name: Healing Field
cards.text: Once during each player's turn, they may flip a coin. If heads, that player removes 2 damage counters from their Active Pokémon (1 if it only has 1).

cards.name: Pokémon Breeder Fields
cards.text: Flip a coin for 1 or 2 of your non-Baby Pokémon that can evolve. For each heads, search your deck for a later-Stage card that matches that Pokémon (your ruling: a card that evolves from it). Then put that card into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

cards.name: Rocket's Hideout
cards.text: Each Pokémon in play with Dark in its name (even your opponent's) gets +20 HP. (Your ruling: Dark Pokémon, whose names start with Dark; Darkrai doesn't count.)

cards.name: Old Rod
cards.text: Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, put a Baby Pokémon, Basic Pokémon, or Evolution card from your discard pile into your hand. If both are tails, put a Trainer card from your discard pile into your hand.

cards.name: Shining Gyarados
cards.text: You can't have more than 1 Shining Gyarados in your deck.

attacks.name: Outrage
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Devastate
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy cards attached to this Pokémon or this attack does nothing. This attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (No Weakness or Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Then, flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Energy card attached to each of your opponent's Pokémon that has any Energy cards attached to it and discard those Energy cards.
